title: Eric Mutema
bio_paragraphs: A developer with a keen eye for design, roaming the digital plains since long before the trails were paved. Based in Nairobi, working with clients across the globe.

I partner with web agencies, enterprises, startups, and individuals to craft exceptional digital experiences — from conception through orchestration. Independent, agile, and relentlessly detail-oriented.
Whether it's a bespoke membership platform, an e-commerce ecosystem, or a custom plugin powered by AI — every pixel and every line of code is treated as part of something alive.
specialties: Bricks Builder, Elementor & ACF Power User
